notes: Axes are rolled IN ORDER. Each option has a base weight 'w'. Options may declare 'tags'; later options may declare 'affinity' — a map of tag -> multiplier applied to their weight if that tag was picked up earlier. A multiplier of 0 forbids the combination. This is how the matrix stays coherent instead of producing random mush.

options.label: Ocean world
options.hook: endless sea, no land to stand on, pressure and dark below

options.label: Desert world
options.hook: scarcity as the first law; water is currency, shade is architecture

options.label: Gas giant
options.hook: life in the cloud decks; nothing has ever touched a surface

options.label: Hothouse jungle world
options.hook: evolution in fast-forward; everything is eating everything

options.label: Rogue ice world
options.hook: no sun; life huddles around geothermal veins under the ice

options.label: Tidally locked eyeball world
options.hook: one eternal day-side furnace, one night-side tomb, life on the ring of dusk

options.label: High-gravity super-earth
options.hook: squat, strong, slow to fly, almost impossible to reach orbit

options.label: Low-gravity moon of a giant
options.hook: a banded giant fills half the sky; leaping is nearly flying

options.label: Volcanic world
options.hook: the ground itself is unreliable; fire is a neighbour, not a tool

options.label: Shattered world / belt
options.hook: an archipelago of tumbling rock; the homeworld is a debris field

options.label: Carbon / water
options.hook: familiar chemistry, alien everything else

options.label: Carbon / ammonia (cryolife)
options.hook: slow cold chemistry; they think in decades and freeze at a touch of warmth

options.label: Silicon-based
options.hook: living stone and glass; they exhale sand, their dead become geology

options.label: Sulfur / thermovore
options.hook: they eat heat gradients; cities cluster on vents like flowers on a stem

options.label: Crystalline lattice life
options.hook: thought is a standing wave in a lattice; they grow rather than age

options.label: Energy-based (field life)
options.hook: coherent fields, not flesh; their 'lineage' is what they were before they ascended

options.label: Post-biological (machine descendants)
options.hook: the builders are gone or transformed; the species IS its former tools

axes.label: Ancestral lineage
axes.notes: For energy_being or mechanical substrates, read this axis as 'what they descended from BEFORE transformation'.

options.label: Avian analog
options.hook: hollow-boned grace; culture obsessed with altitude, song, and sightlines

options.label: Cephalopod analog
options.hook: distributed brains, skin that speaks in colour

options.label: Arthropod / insectoid
options.hook: moults as rites of passage; the shed shells of ancestors are sacred

options.label: Warm-blooded social animal
options.hook: grief, grooming, and grudges; the familiar made strange

options.label: Reptilian analog
options.hook: patience as physiology; they bask, they wait, they remember

options.label: Motile plant / photosynthetic
options.hook: hunger is optional but light is politics

options.label: Fungal / colonial organism
options.hook: the individual is a temporary fruiting body of something older

options.label: Sessile filter feeder that learned to move
options.hook: they spent a million years watching before they ever acted

options.label: Burrowing animal
options.hook: the surface is myth; their history is measured in depth

options.label: Pack predator
options.hook: cooperation sharpened by the hunt; loyalty and hierarchy in the blood

options.label: Herd prey animal
options.hook: a civilisation built by the watched; paranoia matured into philosophy

options.label: Eusocial hive organism
options.hook: the question 'who are you?' has a plural answer

options.label: Carcinization — everything turns to crab
options.hook: armour, claws, sideways gait; they know other species mock this, and do not care — the crab shape WINS

options.label: Radial symmetry
options.hook: no front, no back, no facing; their doors, art and warfare assume attack from anywhere

options.label: Buoyant floater / living airship
options.hook: they drift; urgency is a foreign concept acquired late and badly

options.label: Modular / detachable colonial body
options.hook: they lend limbs, swap organs, and vote by physical merger

options.label: Serpentine / limbless
options.hook: tools shaped for a body that is one long muscle

options.label: Megafauna scale
options.hook: each individual is a walking village; population in the thousands, not billions

options.label: Micro-scale swarm
options.hook: a 'person' is a cloud; handshakes are a merging

options.label: Amorphous / shape-fluid
options.hook: identity without fixed form; portraiture is considered hilarious

options.label: Echolocation
options.hook: privacy means silence; their cities are shaped like instruments

options.label: Electroreception
options.hook: they feel heartbeats and lies; poker never developed

options.label: Magnetoreception
options.hook: the planet's field is a landscape; solar storms are weather, omens, holidays

options.label: Thermal / infrared sight
options.hook: warmth is colour; the dead literally fade to grey

options.label: Chemical / pheromonal
options.hook: mood is public; their libraries are scent archives that must be walked through

options.label: Seismic / vibration
options.hook: speech travels through stone; strangers are felt long before they are met

options.label: Networked gestalt sense
options.hook: perception is pooled; an isolated individual is functionally blind

options.label: Dawn culture (pre-industrial)
options.hook: first cities, first writing, first wars worth naming

options.label: Young and expansionist
options.hook: loud, hungry, certain; a species-wide adolescence

options.label: Mature interstellar culture
options.hook: the wild edges institutionalised; greatness maintained rather than won

options.label: Ancient and inward-turned
options.hook: they solved their problems long ago and have been living in the answer ever since

options.label: Post-collapse remnant
options.hook: they live in the basement of their own golden age

options.label: Caretaker remnant of a departed race
options.hook: the masters ascended or died; the servants kept the lights on and became someone

options.label: On the edge of transcendence
options.hook: half the species has already left; the ones who remain must explain why

options.label: Clan and honor-debt
options.hook: every favour is a ledger entry; ancestry is jurisprudence

options.label: Eusocial castes
options.hook: born to a role, and mostly at peace with it — the exceptions make the stories

options.label: Gerontocracy of the long-lived
options.hook: the young wait centuries for a voice; some stop waiting

options.label: Distributed consensus, no rulers
options.hook: decisions percolate; outsiders can never find who is in charge, because no one is

options.label: Obligate symbiotic pairs
options.hook: two species, one civilisation; every citizen is a partnership

options.label: Machine-stewarded
options.hook: an artificial steward governs by ancient mandate no one living wrote

options.label: Nomadic bands / fleets
options.hook: home is a route, not a place; wealth is what survives the journey

options.label: Rule by the best rememberers
options.hook: status flows to those who carry the most past; forgetting is abdication

options.label: Forged machines (fire and metal)
options.hook: the classic path: smelt, forge, burn, launch

options.label: Grown biotech
options.hook: ships are bred, tools are cultivated, cities are pruned

options.label: Vent-smiths (geothermal metallurgy)
options.hook: industry chained to the planet's own furnaces; power is geography

options.label: Precursor-tech scavengers
options.hook: they operate what they cannot rebuild; every device is scripture and time-bomb

options.label: Deliberate refusers
options.hook: they had it all and put it down; the reason is the story

options.label: Field manipulation
options.hook: no tools you could pick up; their engineering is done to space itself

options.label: The homeworld is gone
options.hook: everything they build is a quotation of a place that no longer exists

options.label: A war won at ruinous cost
options.hook: victory hollowed them; the enemy is gone and so is what they were defending

options.label: Their sun is dying on a known schedule
options.hook: a civilisation-wide deadline; every institution bends around the departure date

options.label: A flaw written into their own biology
options.hook: the enemy is inherited; every generation negotiates with it anew

options.label: A religion built on a misunderstood precursor artifact
options.hook: the object is real, the interpretation is theirs; both facts are dangerous

options.label: They were once another species' property
options.hook: uplifted, kept, or farmed — freedom is recent and the scars are structural

options.label: They called into the dark for millennia; nothing answered
options.hook: first contact will break something in them, one way or the other

options.label: They did something unforgivable, and remember it
options.hook: the atrocity is theirs; the culture is an apparatus for carrying it

options.label: Curiosity above safety
options.hook: they will open the door, every time

options.label: Grief as the organising emotion
options.hook: mourning is their art form, their calendar, and their diplomacy

options.label: Obligation and reciprocity
options.hook: nothing is free and nothing is forgotten; generosity is a weapon

options.label: Aesthetic obsession
options.hook: ugliness is the only sin; their warships are beautiful and this is not incidental

options.label: Humor as sacrament
options.hook: the joke is holy; their scriptures are funny on purpose and translators despair

options.label: Radical hospitality
options.hook: the guest is sacred even when the guest is a threat — especially then

options.label: Ruthless pragmatism
options.hook: sentiment is a luxury tax they refuse to pay; they are honest about it, which is worse

options.label: Deep-time patience
options.hook: they plan in geological time; a grudge can outlive a mountain range

options.label: Iridescent chitin and grown coral
options.hook: cities grown, not built; surfaces that shimmer like beetle shells

options.label: Bone, hide, and windworn textile
options.hook: nomad elegance; nothing carried that doesn't earn its weight

options.label: Bioluminescent deep-sea palette
options.hook: black water, living light; language and lighting are the same medium

options.label: Membrane, silk, and tension structures
options.hook: architecture that weighs almost nothing; beauty measured in lift

options.label: Geometric crystal brutalism
options.hook: grown monoliths, refracted light, right angles found in nature nowhere else

options.label: Woven living wood and root
options.hook: buildings that are still alive and occasionally have opinions

options.label: Fused glass and ash-field ceramics
options.hook: beauty made from catastrophe's leftovers

options.label: Lacquer, ceramic, and ritual repair
options.hook: everything old is mended visibly in gold; age is the ornament

options.label: Rust, salvage, and reverent patchwork
options.hook: the ancestors' machines worn as armour and altar

options.label: Individuals are temporary; memory is pooled
options.hook: death is a formality; the archive is the person

options.label: They mourn befriendings, celebrate deaths
options.hook: their model of time or self inverts an emotional constant we assume is universal

options.label: Their true language is architecture
options.hook: speech is small talk; to say something that matters, they build it

options.label: They find US terrifying
options.hook: some ordinary human trait — endurance, symbiotic gut flora, dreaming — is their horror-story material

options.label: Their science is done asleep
options.hook: a caste of dreamers computes; waking life merely implements

options.label: The entire species is legally/biologically one organism
options.hook: war with them is surgery; diplomacy is neurochemistry

options.label: They have chosen extinction, calmly
options.hook: not despair — completion; visitors find this unbearable, they find it obvious
